saw_lines: Men rarely browse menswear for fun. They buy the shirt that fits, then reorder the same cut in a new shade.
So the offer and the fit have to land in the first line, or the tap never comes.
Your site offers 200 OFF a first order, yet 0 of 18 ads mention it. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 200 OFF on a first order, yet 0 of 18 ads mention it or any offer, so new buyers get no reason to act. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.
None of your 30 live ads carries a proof number. A new buyer has no figure to trust before paying, so the ad asks for faith. Collect one real number and open the next batch with it.

5 of your 18 fixed copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page, which buyers read as an ad, not a person. Whitelist those posts from the creator’s account and cut three variations of the best one.
7 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown. A buyer who taps Shop now expects the item in the ad, not a front page. Point each of those 7 ads to the product it shows.

ads_1: Creator style video ads opening on the 200 OFF first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram and Youtube, your linked channels
